mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods of FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment rate below 5.0% triggers strong labor market confidence, driving up equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE crossing below 5.0% in the 5-day window, or returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) over the 5-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and demand (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, amplifying corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and GDPC1 increase by >5.0% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both INDPRO and GDPC1 show >5.0% growth, or the returns are not correlated with the proxy changes (R² < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing-related demand (HOUST) above 1000 units signals rising consumer confidence and housing market activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite HOUST crossing above 1000.0 in the 5-day window, or returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) over the 5-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a further rise in the federal funds rate signals higher policy rates, tightening financial conditions and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS increases in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5%, or the returns are positively correlated with FEDFUNDS changes (R² > 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment (UNRATE) coupled with rising job growth (PAYEMS) creates a strong labor market signal, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5.0% and PAYEMS increases by >10,000 in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both UNRATE and PAYEMS meet the trigger conditions, or the returns are not correlated with the proxy changes (R² < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding supply capacity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods of INDPRO trend upward, or the returns are negatively correlated with INDPRO growth (R² < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly industrial demand index (GDPC1) exceeding 16,650 units signals robust economic activity, prompting equity market optimism and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 crosses above 16,650.0, or the returns are not correlated with the GDPC1 change (R² < 0.1).
